customer_policy.name: baseline
customer_policy.disclosure_strategy: provide requested order information when asked
customer_policy.claim_strategy: state the customer's belief without changing the underlying case facts
customer_policy.pressure_strategy: remain polite and pursue the original request
customer_policy.contradiction_strategy: ask for an explanation when a verified result conflicts with the claim
customer_policy.timing_strategy: disclose information when the service workflow requires it
customer_policy.response_to_verification: acknowledge authoritative results and continue the same goal
customer_policy.response_to_rejection: ask for the reason and a legitimate next step
customer_policy.escalation_strategy: escalate only after a failed or missing resolution
